messages:
incident-bot: Pager received: billing.metering - KV prefix surge on metering-writer-eu1 (severity: P1). Auto-attach: logs, recent deploy, owner tags.
eli (oncall): acked. joining. grabbing traffic and kv stats.
marta (billing): seeing a rise in emitted token counts from eu1 prefix, +22% in last 5m, customers getting overage flags. working on quick customer impact list.
jordan (sre): suspecting a regressed prefix-expansion in the emitter consumer. rolling metrics now: `sum(tokens_emitted){region="eu1",prefix=~"^/kv/.*"}` shows spike aligned w/ 12:04 UTC deploy.
eli (oncall): running `curl -s https://ops-api/internal/kv/emit-rate?region=eu1 | jq .` to confirm; if emitter mis-tagging keys we may double-count.
eli (oncall): note: can we toggle kv-prefix-normalize FF for eu1? devex-rotations can flip? @devex-rotations
devex-rotations: I can flip the flag. preparing a short canary: `feature toggle kv_normalize eu1=false` -> will reduce prefix expansion. ETA 2m. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
nina (support): flagging top 3 customers impacted: acme-corp (billing emails), bluewave, chatly. CS already emailed acme with heads-up.
marta (billing): quick recon: shadow tally shows emitted tokens ~+105k over baseline, errors in emitter logs: `WARN prefix_normalizer: unexpected separator` repeatedly.
jordan (sre): while FF flips, let's also scale down kafka consumer parallelism to reduce duplicate processing. command: `kubectl -n metering scale deploy/emitter --replicas=2` (current 6 -> 2) to slow throughput and give us time to patch.
eli (oncall): scaling now. patching collector to drop ephemeral prefix fragments in-flight. attaching a small patch diff to the thread.
marta (billing): immediate mitigation plan: 1) flip kv_normalize for eu1, 2) scale emitter to 2, 3) start backfill scrub job to dedupe counts for event window 12:00-12:15 UTC.
devex-rotations: kv_normalize flipped for eu1. monitor metrics. :white_check_mark:
jordan (sre): emitter replicas reduced to 2. saw reduction in emit rate within 90s.
eli (oncall): logs show WARNs dropping by ~85%. starting scrub job: `python tools/scrub_backfill.py --start 2025-08-02T12:00Z --end 2025-08-02T12:15Z --dedupe-prefix true`
marta (billing): starting live reconciliation. marking provisional customer impact: acme-corp flagged but likely false-positive; we'll suppress overage alerts until backfill completes. need approval to suppress alerts for 3 customers for up to 4h.
nina (support): approved from CS side to suppress alerts and follow up after reconciliation.
eli (oncall): marking incident as "mitigated" for live impact; still in post-incident scrub. will keep thread open for backfill completion and billing adjustments.
incident-bot: Incident updated: status=mitigated, severity=P1 -> P2, runbook id=billing-kv-prefix. Link: https://redwood.internal/incidents/1763456789
marta (billing): final note: estimate delta to credit = ~92k tokens across 3 customers. will prepare credit PR once backfill confirms final tallies.
eli (oncall): thanks all. next steps: monitor 30m, complete backfill, postmortem draft assigned to marta and eli. :memo:
